'''Version 1.8.2''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on August 5th 2020.  It was 5.32 MB.  When the mod had its [[#Trivia|first popularity boom]], 1.8.2 was the most recent version.

== ''Change Log'' ==

* Fixed kill command not killing mobs with damage cap > 1
* Reduced mob death animation time
* Fixed [[Moving Flesh]] growing too much and not spawning mobs
* Fixed crash cause by the "new task" options not being compatible with some entities
*# This does not mean that an incompatible entity can work the task

== ''Trivia'' ==
* The video to push Scape and Run: Parasites into the public eye was published by textConjure on March 3rd, 2021.  You can watch it [https://youtu.be/GLluVgrpz4k here]!
